blurb: E.B. Rains, Jr. Memorial Park is a popular park in the north metro area featuring multi-sport fields, basketball courts, pedal boat and kayak rentals, fishing, and a self-guided tour around Webster Lake. The park includes pavilions, sculptures, and a memorial skatepark. It hosts events such as Pirate Fest, July 4th Festival, Derby Day, and Breast Cancer Walk.
